title: LCO instrument-web deployment
description: One telescope or test deployment: its Cloudflare subdomain, its gateway, and the instruments and guiders present on it.

name.description: Deployment id; also the Cloudflare subdomain label and the filename stem.

title.description: Human name for the landing page.

domain.description: Fully qualified hostname. One Access application covers it; instruments are paths on it, never subdomains.

app.description: Key into instruments/ports.yml; also the instruments/<app>/ UI directory and the /<app>/ws path.

port.description: Overrides the derived port from instruments/ports.yml. Only for a non-standard build.

quicklook.description: FITS producer: mount /image/<app>/ and add a Quick Look sub-tab.

fits_root.description: Path translation when the gateway is not the instrument host. Omit when they are the same machine.

name.description: Must match an lco-ansible gcam_guiders[].name; also the /guider/<name>/ path.

gnum.description: Guider number: commands on 52200+gnum, image server on 52300+gnum.

tcs_mode.description: gcamzwo -t: 0 offline, 1 Baade, 2 Clay, else a TCSIS simulator.

gcam_name.description: The name gcamweb serves this guider under, which is also its URL: /guider/<gcam_name>/. gcamweb requires gcamPG (rotator-port digit + guider number 1-3) and rejects anything else, so an operational name like 'pfs-sv' cannot be used in the path. Defaults to name.

access.description: Cloudflare Access allowed list. Either a whole-domain wildcard (*@example.edu, the only wildcard form Access supports) or an exact address. An empty list locks the deployment down to nobody.

inventoryHost.description: An lco-ansible inventory hostname. Checked to exist; not necessarily resolvable in DNS.

address.description: What the gateway actually dials, when the inventory hostname does not resolve. Defaults to host.
